tools.name: video_probe
tools.description: Read metadata of a local video file with ffprobe. Returns duration, resolution, frame rate, bitrate and whether an audio track exists. Use this first to learn how long a video is before extracting frames from it.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a local video file.

summary.zh: 读一个本地视频文件的元数据：时长、分辨率、帧率、码率、有没有音轨。
summary.en: Reads a local video file’s duration, resolution, frame rate, bitrate and whether it has audio.

tools.name: video_frames
tools.description: Extract frames from a local video file as JPEG images so you can see what is on screen. Pass fromSec alone to grab a single frame at that second; pass count (or intervalSec) to grab several frames spread over the video. The images are attached to the tool result, so a model that accepts image input can look at them directly.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a local video file.

fromSec.description: Where to start, in seconds. Default 0.

count.description: How many frames to extract. 1 means a single frame at fromSec. Default comes from config (worlds.video.defaultCount).

intervalSec.description: Seconds between consecutive frames. Default comes from config (worlds.video.defaultIntervalSec).

scale.description: Output width in pixels, aspect ratio preserved. 0 keeps the original size. Default comes from config (worlds.video.defaultScale).

summary.zh: 从本地视频抽帧成 jpg 图片，直接作为图片回传，让模型看见某一刻画面。
summary.en: Extracts frames from a local video as JPEG images and returns them so the model can see them.

prompts.title: Video · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
Video World 让你看本地视频文件的内容，只读传入路径的文件，不联网、不上传。

- 想看一个视频长什么样：先调 `video_probe` 拿时长、分辨率、帧率、有没有音轨，再决定从哪一刻抽帧。
- 想看某一刻在播什么：调 `video_frames` 只传 `path` 和 `fromSec`，会抽出那一秒的单帧图片。
- 想通看一遍：调 `video_frames` 传 `count`（和可选的 `intervalSec`），会按间隔抽多帧一起回传。
- 图太大或太多时可以传 `scale` 压宽度；一次最多抽 `worlds.video.maxCount` 张。
- ffmpeg / ffprobe 从 PATH 找，找不到时回执会写清楚怎么装；也可以在配置里填绝对路径。
- 抽出来的 jpg 落在 `worlds.video.framesDir`（留空则用系统临时目录），回执里会给出每个文件的时间点和路径。

changelog.0.1.0:
首个版本。

- `video_probe`：ffprobe 读本地视频元数据（时长、分辨率、帧率、码率、音轨有无）。
- `video_frames`：ffmpeg 抽帧成 jpg 并以图片回传，支持单帧（`fromSec`）与多帧（`count` + `intervalSec`）。
- 默认 `count=6`、`intervalSec=5`、`scale=640`，均可在 `worlds.video` 配置段调整。
- ffmpeg / ffprobe 从 PATH 查找，找不到时回执写明安装方式。
